coachHint.message: Hover an element and click to lock it, then choose an action. Use Q/W to move through its parents.

coachStep1.message: Hover an element and click to lock it; Q and W move the selection up or down.

coachStep2.message: Pick an action: hide, edit text, round corners — or open ⋯ for more.

coachStep3.message: Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes; “Remember new edits” keeps changes for this site.

onboardTagline.message: Hide clutter, replace visible text, and restyle page elements.

onboardStep1Body.message: Click the Elements icon in the toolbar or press Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+X on any website.

onboardStep2Body.message: Hover an element and click to lock it, then choose an action: hide it, edit its text, round its corners, blur or dim it.

onboardStep3Body.message: Saved edits apply on later visits and may sync through browser-managed storage.

onboardPrivacyBody.message: No analytics, ads, remote code, or developer-operated server. Saved rules and settings may sync through your browser account when browser sync is available.
